statements.impact_statement: PostgreSQL states that only major version 18 is affected and that versions before PostgreSQL 18 are unaffected: https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-16238/. The flaw is in pg_restore_attribute_stats(), a statistics import function added in PostgreSQL 18 (src/backend/statistics/attribute_stats.c), which does not exist in the PostgreSQL 16 sources: https://github.com/postgres/postgres/tree/REL_16_16/src/backend/statistics has no attribute_stats.c and the REL_16_16 function catalog (src/include/catalog/pg_proc.dat) has no such function. This owner publishes PostgreSQL 16 only (16.13-r0, 16.14-r0, 16.15-r0 and 16.16-r0 for Alpine 3.23). In every published build, on both x86_64 and aarch64, the postgres server binary reports a PostgreSQL 16 release, and neither it nor the system catalog bootstrap file (postgres.bki) contains the name pg_restore_attribute_stats. Alpine lists this CVE under its 16.15-r0 secfixes, but the PostgreSQL 16.15 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/16.15/, do not include it.

statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-16238 (PostgreSQL type confusion in pg_restore_attribute_stats() executes arbitrary code) affects PostgreSQL 18 before 18.6 and is fixed upstream in PostgreSQL 18.6: https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-16238/ lists 18.6 as the fixed release for major version 18, and the 18.6 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/18.6/, list it. The fix is commit https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/08454e8b2defdf8a0b61e550606f78b8f184f2e6 on the REL_18_STABLE branch, tagged Security: CVE-2026-16238, which is in the REL_18_6 release tag and not in REL_18_4; it changes only src/backend/statistics/attribute_stats.c (and the regression tests), so that range and multirange statistics values are no longer conflated. PostgreSQL 18.5 was never released (the 18.6 release notes say so), so although Alpine's postgresql18 APKBUILD, https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/59a1f1d230675807d5a95a0c1e57ba5d640ba039/main/postgresql18/APKBUILD, lists CVE-2026-16238 under an 18.5-r0 secfixes entry, this owner has no 18.5-r0 build and its first build that carries the fix is 18.6-r0. The DHI postgresql18 packages for Alpine 3.23 are built with Alpine's postgresql18 APKBUILD from the upstream PostgreSQL source release of the same version. As of 2026-11-27 the DHI Alpine 3.23 package repository publishes builds of source postgresql18 at 18.1-r0, 18.2-r0, 18.3-r0, 18.4-r0, 18.6-r0 and 18.7-r0, for x86_64 and aarch64, and we checked every one of them on both architectures, with package checksums verified against the repository index. The affected function is present in every one of those builds on both architectures: the server binary /usr/libexec/postgresql18/postgres in the postgresql18 package and the system catalog bootstrap file postgres.bki both contain pg_restore_attribute_stats. In each build the version strings of the postgres server binary and of the client programs (psql, pg_dump, pg_dumpall, pg_restore, pg_basebackup and pg_config) report the PostgreSQL release that matches the package version (18.1, 18.2, 18.3, 18.4, 18.6 and 18.7 respectively). The fix adds no message text that marks it in the binaries, so the boundary rests on the release each build reports. 18.6-r0 is the first published build carrying the fix, and 18.6-r0 and 18.7-r0 carry it. The earlier published builds (18.1-r0, 18.2-r0, 18.3-r0 and 18.4-r0) are built from PostgreSQL releases before 18.6 and are affected.
